title: Brown's patents bought by Sharper Image for ion air filters

tellings.quote: He also I believe was responsible for the patents that ended up you know Sharper Image ended up buying them

plain: Patents from the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, who worked on using electricity to push objects through the air, are said to have ended up with Sharper Image, the gadget retailer, which used the idea in its ion air purifiers. Michels mentions this himself, hedging with "I believe" and naming no source. He raises it to show that Brown's unusual work reached ordinary consumer products.
